govdocs-archive_org-nsia-HuieWilliamBrad: An excerpt preserves the prologue of He Slew the Dreamer, William Bradford Huie's book on the killing of Martin Luther King Jr. The identification of the excerpt is marked probable in the record rather than certain. Huie wrote narrative accounts of famous crimes, and his King book followed the hunt for the killer. The entry stands as the opening pages of that work.
